description: Instrument calibration, with no recipe change. Rerun the unchanged tip (E086 code) on seeds 3-10 in at least 3 fresh processes through the benchmark's trial code. Each process rebuilds, so cuDNN benchmark picks are resampled. Continue until there are >=2 off-seed samples that are not bit-identical. Log the per-seed final-weight checksums (H4.4.1) and the cuDNN conv kernel names per (layer, shape) (H4.5.1). Report the sd of the 8-seed off-seed mean across the non-identical samples, and check whether the run means cluster by algorithm set. For the scored row, rerun the tip once; it adds a non-bit-identical tip sample if one occurs.
